name: Published immutability
rule: Published versions are immutable; corrections create a new version.

name: Effective dating
rule: Only one applicable published version may be selected for the same tenant/base scope and effective context unless policy explicitly permits layering.

name: Tenant override precedence
rule: Tenant override may replace allowed fields while preserving base record provenance and identifier linkage.

name: Unit compatibility
rule: Assembly/rate quantities require dimensionally compatible units or approved conversions.

name: Dependency integrity
rule: Assemblies cannot publish with missing/superseded/unapproved required dependencies.

name: Rate provenance
rule: Rates/prices retain source, effective date, geography, currency/unit and approval evidence.

name: No silent AI writeback
rule: AI proposals never publish directly; human approval creates governed draft/version state.

name: Estimator reproducibility
rule: Estimates may reference a library snapshot/version so later library changes do not alter historical estimate math.

name: Editable service catalog
rule: Authorized tenant users can add/edit services and categories under version/audit rules.

name: Service persistence from estimator
rule: New approved estimator-created service definitions can be written to the service catalog through governed writeback.

name: Crew composition
rule: Crew templates store member roles/counts and may reference required equipment/resources.

name: Equipment multi-period rate
rule: Equipment rates can carry hourly/daily/weekly/monthly structures without assuming linear equivalence.

name: Truck pricing modes
rule: Truck resources/rates support hourly and trip/load-based pricing modes.

name: Haul configuration
rule: Haul/disposal records preserve distance, cycle assumptions, capacity and fee basis when applicable.

name: Regionalization layering
rule: Regional factors apply only according to configured profile/rule and do not silently double-adjust vendor/custom quotes.

name: Import preview
rule: Bulk import validates and previews changes before governed commit.

name: Archive not delete
rule: Referenced published records are archived/superseded rather than physically removed.
